components.name: Keycap Button
components.description: Tactile keycap button with physical travel and acoustic click feedback.
components.css: .ds-key { min-height: 3.1rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.3rem 1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 650; font-stretch: 112%; color: #1a0d06; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff7a45, #ff5a1f 70%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55), inset 0 -5px 0 #b8380c, 0 7px 14px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.65); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 90ms, box-shadow 90ms; } .ds-key:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4), inset 0 -2px 0 #b8380c, 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,.6); }

narrative.overview: The visual world of Sakib Alam Mubin treats the screen as a physical hardware security workbench rather than an abstract SaaS landing page.
keyCharacteristics: Material Ground Alternation: Dark aluminium and bone PBT plastic.
Tactile Keycap Controls: Physical travel and synthesized Web Audio feedback.
Hardware Authenticity: Continuous cord specular, machined bulkheads, and status LEDs.
Strict Typographic Roles: Archivo variable for narrative, JetBrains Mono strictly for code.

rules.name: The Strict Semantic Bevel Rule
rules.body: Depressed bottom-lip shadow bevels are granted exclusively to interactive keys, caps, and switches.

rules.name: The Reserved Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is permitted only in code sandboxes, file paths, HTTP headers, and the command terminal.

dos: Do maintain the strict alternating rhythm of Dark Aluminium (#111215) and Bone Polymer (#E6E0D2) fields.
Do preserve the physical travel and Web Audio click feedback on all newly added button-like controls.
Do keep Sakib Alam Mubin and short name SA Mubin verbatim in all entity tags.
donts: Don't use JetBrains Mono for conversational copy or contact forms.
Don't add bevels or bottom-lip shadows to static containers.
Don't introduce generic AI slop: no glowing halos or bouncy cartoon easings.
